observations: The rig daemon was started from this workspace's working copy (jj diff --from dd224351 --to @ --summary = A .legion/implement.json, A .omp/config.yml), i.e. the PR's code head.

A daemon started from inside a Legion worker pane inherits the pane's LEGION_TREE/LEGION_ROLE/LEGION_OMP_PATH; the first rig attempt's omp_launch_prefix saw LEGION_TREE=LEGION-59 in the probe's environment and went inert, so the pi.agents probe timed out at 300 s. Fixed by starting the daemon with LEGION_*/JJ_CONFIG/DISPATCH_*/ENVOY_* scrubbed (env -u), after which both probes passed. Not a defect in this PR; a rig-procedure gotcha for docs/solutions/testing/scratch-daemon-rig-proves-what-unit-tests-cannot.md.

Text-injection grant preamble (installed pi-legion-envoy 1.17.0): reproducing the injected `export LEGION_GRANT=...` lines in a later bash command overrides the real grant and makes `legion gh` fail with `Unable to redeem LEGION_GRANT (403)`. The implementer's trickyParts note is accurate; issuing the bare command (or `eval` -> `tool.bash`) avoids it.
Status wobble recorded by the plan (a tester completion always writes needs_review) is untouched by this PR and was not exercised.

Tester rules for this tree, from the architect: never rebase; after a conflict-forced rebase with an unchanged fingerprint re-run only the bare gates (CI green at the new head, bash scripts/smoke/up.test.sh) and update the E2E head SHA; once .legion/ is deleted on this branch never recreate it and report with legion handoff complete alone.
documentationFeedback: docs/solutions/testing/scratch-daemon-rig-proves-what-unit-tests-cannot.md should say the rig daemon must be started with the tester pane's LEGION_* environment scrubbed (env -u LEGION_TREE ... or an operator-style shell); otherwise the boot probes inherit LEGION_TREE/LEGION_ROLE and a role-keyed launch prefix misfires. It should also name the logging Dispatch proxy trick as the request-level proof for 'the daemon issued no PATCH'.
